name: rmaciel-work-admin
_comment_type: 'type': 'module' is deliberately ABSENT. It would make Node treat build.js as an ES module, and build.js is CommonJS — the site build dies with 'require is not defined in ES module scope'. Astro does not need it: astro.config.mjs already carries the extension that marks it a module.
_comment_versions: Every version is exact, no carets. @keystatic/core is pre-1.0, so a minor release may break the custom marks. react-aria and react-stately are pinned by Keystatic to EXACT versions (3.50.0 / 3.48.0) — installing their latest breaks the peer tree.
_comment_build: build:site alone still produces the entire website on Node built-ins, with node_modules deleted. The admin is additive.
